subtopic: Managed Relational Databases (RDS / Aurora) Multi-AZ vs Read Replicas
question_text: [Cloud Storage, Databases & Lifecycle Policies - Q23] In Amazon RDS, what is the fundamental architectural difference between Multi-AZ deployment and Read Replicas?

options.text: Multi-AZ uses synchronous block-level physical replication to a standby instance in another availability zone for automated failover (high availability); Read Replicas use asynchronous engine-level replication to serve read traffic
Read Replicas handle automated failover; Multi-AZ only serves read traffic
Multi-AZ is hosted in another AWS region
Read replicas cannot be promoted to standalone instances

answer_explanation: Multi-AZ is a disaster recovery and high-availability mechanism: the standby is not accessible for queries and syncs synchronously. Read replicas replicate asynchronously and actively scale read query capacity.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: A. Rationale: Multi-AZ is a disaster recovery and high-availability mechanism: the standby is not accessible for queries and syncs synchronously. Read replicas replicate asynchronously and actively scale read query capacity.
